summary.name: Calendly
summary.one_liner: Calendly is a meeting scheduling platform that lets people book time through shared links, with added AI assistant, meeting notetaking, follow-up, and payment tools.
use_cases: Sharing a booking link so clients can pick a meeting time
Having an AI assistant coordinate times over email
Charging upfront or collecting payment when booking
Getting automatic notes and action items after a call
Preparing for client meetings using contact history
Sending follow-up emails with invoice links
summary.what_it_does: Calendly is a scheduling tool built around meetings. Users share booking links so others can pick open times, and they can customize the booking flow. Callie, described as an AI scheduling assistant, can be added to an email thread to coordinate times on the user's behalf. Notetaker captures conversations during calls and delivers a recap and action items after the meeting. The platform also offers built-in payment features, including charging upfront, selling packages, and sending invoices, plus pre-meeting prep using contact history and follow-up email drafts. The page lists a range of integrations with other tools.
notable: Callie AI assistant that can be added to email threads to handle scheduling
Notetaker produces meeting recaps and action items after calls
Built-in payments, packages, and invoices tied to bookings
caveats: Pricing tiers and plan limits are not stated on the page; the listing marks it as freemium
Specific AI and notetaker features may depend on plan, which the page does not detail
